messages:
Maria (PS): Quick sync with Nimbus marketplace team — they're seeing hourly usage spikes disappear when we ingest minute-level events. Can we meet asap to agree on a reconciliation approach?

Josh (Infra): Saw this. probable ingestion windowing + timezone rounding. can you share sample payloads?

Maria (PS): Uploaded sample bundle: https://s3.redwood/example/nimbus-minutes.zip — partner says entitlements sometimes activate 5–10m after usage, so credits don't line up.

Devin (Billing): If entitlements activate late that could cause negative deltas during hourly rollups. Suggestion: 1) idempotent upsert by event_id, 2) grace window of 15m for entitlement activation when attributing credits, 3) log source of truth per record.

Anna (Eng): Agree. Practical approach: when computing hourly aggregates, backfill by including minute-level events with timestamp >= hour_start - 15m. Also add a "claimed_by" field from partner payload if present.

Josh (Infra): Implementation note: our ingestion lambda currently groups by hour using floor(ts, 1h) which loses minute granularity. Options: a) store raw events and run streaming hourly rollups from a materialized view, or b) accept partner-provided hour bucket (risky). Storing raw events increases storage ~+8% but keeps correctness.

Devin (Billing): For retroactive backfills we need an adjustment policy. Proposal: auto-apply credits for adjustments <= threshold (e.g., 100 tokens equivalent) and within 24h; anything larger goes to ops review queue and appears in the billing audit log. Credits must be visible in the console with clear provenance.

Maria (PS): @Anna can you draft a short replay/backfill playbook and list artifacts we need for audit? Nimbus will prepare a script to re-send minute events.

Anna (Eng): Draft playbook (v0):
```
Playbook v0:
1) Partner replays minute CSV with columns: event_id,timestamp,usage_units,entitlement_id,tenant_id/accountId
2) Redwood ingests into raw_events (idempotent upsert on event_id)
3) Backfill worker recomputes affected hourly aggregates and emits adjustment records (adjustment_id, reason, delta, source_event_ids)
4) Billing applies auto-credit if adjustment <= 100 tokens AND within 24h, otherwise route to manual review queue
5) All adjustments write an audit record and are surfaced in Console -> Billing -> Adjustments
```

Josh (Infra): Also found payload mismatch: Nimbus sends `accountId` while we use `tenant_id`. We'll add a per-partner mapping config to translation layer so partners don't need to change right away.

Maria (PS): Nimbus agreed to mapping. They also want an SLA: reconciliation visible in console within 30m of ingestion. Can we commit? :eyes:

Josh (Infra): 30m is tight but achievable if we enable streaming aggregator + materialized view. We'll need to flip streaming mode for partner:nimbus and estimate infra +0.2 RPS per active account; ops impact minimal but we'll schedule a canary.

Devin (Billing): Summarizing agreed asks: 30m visibility, 24h auto-credit window, 15m entitlement grace, partner-to-Redwood mapping support, replay/playbook + audit artifacts. I'll own the RFC for billing adjustment rules and the threshold numbers.

marketplace-bot: Deploy scheduled: enable streaming-aggregator for partner:nimbus on 2024-11-12 02:00 UTC :calendar: 

Maria (PS): Thanks all. I'll loop Nimbus and share the playbook + replay checklist. pls @channel add any missing items or concerns. :thumbsup:
